WHAT: Complete Windows ARM build environment for Whisnap
INSTALLED:
  - Git, Node 22, Rust (aarch64-pc-windows-msvc target)
  - VS Build Tools 2022 with: VC ARM64 toolchain, LLVM/Clang component
  - LLVM at: C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Tools\Llvm\ARM64\bin
REQUIRED ENV VARS (must set each session or use batch script):
  LIBCLANG_PATH=C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Tools\Llvm\ARM64\bin
  CC=clang-cl
  CXX=clang-cl
  CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja
  CXXFLAGS=/EHsc
  CFLAGS= (empty)
  Plus: vcvarsall.bat arm64 must be called first
SCRIPTS AT C:\Users\ned\whisnap\:
  build-windows.bat — full release build, outputs exe to desktop
  dev-windows.bat — dev mode (tauri dev = vite + cargo debug)
REPO: Copied via scp from Mac (not git clone — private repo auth issues)
GOTCHA: Use cmd.exe not PowerShell for && chaining
GOTCHA: ARM64 build tools needed explicit VS installer component (not installed by default workload)
GOTCHA: whisper.cpp on ARM requires Clang (not MSVC) + Ninja generator + /EHsc flag
